req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-019 requires GET /openapi.json to return HTTP 2xx with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path verifying exact status code 200 and key OpenAPI fields (openapi version prefix '3.', info.title, info.version, paths dict); (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) must return 405 Method Not Allowed, not 2xx; (3) boundary BVA — the 'openapi' field value must start with '3.' (not '2.' or absent), and 'paths' must be a non-empty dict containing at least the known routes; (4) DT decision-table — verifying the Content-Type header is application/json and the body is parseable JSON (not HTML or plain text). Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions (200 vs 201/204/etc.), exact string prefix checks, exact key presence, exact method-not-allowed code (405), boolean checks on isinstance and key membership.

expected: JSON contains key 'openapi' with value starting with '3.'
JSON contains key 'info' with sub-keys 'title' and 'version'
JSON contains key 'paths' which is a dict
trace: R-TASK-019: serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
EP: valid GET request is the nominal equivalence class
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_positive_status_and_structure():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert body["openapi"].startswith("3.")
    assert "info" in body
    assert body["info"]["title"] == "Task Manager API"
    assert body["info"]["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert "paths" in body
    assert isinstance(body["paths"], dict)
    assert len(body["paths"]) > 0

tests.name: test_openapi_json_boundary_openapi_version_prefix
actions: Check that the version string starts with '3.' and NOT '2.' or '4.'
trace: R-TASK-019: specification must be OpenAPI 3.x — boundary between 2.x and 3.x
BVA: version prefix boundary; catches mutation of version constant
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_boundary_openapi_version_prefix():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in content_type
    body = r.json()
    openapi_ver = body.get("openapi", "")
    assert openapi_ver.startswith("3."), f"Expected OpenAPI 3.x, got: {openapi_ver!r}"
    assert not openapi_ver.startswith("2."), "Must not be OpenAPI 2.x (Swagger)"
    assert not openapi_ver.startswith("4."), "Must not be OpenAPI 4.x"
    major = int(openapi_ver.split(".")[0])
    assert major == 3

tests.name: test_openapi_json_paths_contain_known_routes
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialized with /tasks/ and /tasks/{task_id} routes
actions: Inspect 'paths' dict for expected route keys
trace: R-TASK-019: OpenAPI schema must reflect actual routes defined in app
DT: decision table of route x method combinations
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_paths_contain_known_routes():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    paths = body.get("paths", {})
    assert "/tasks/" in paths, f"'/tasks/' not found in paths: {list(paths.keys())}"
    assert "/tasks/{task_id}" in paths, f"'/tasks/{{task_id}}' not found in paths"
    tasks_collection = paths["/tasks/"]
    assert "get" in tasks_collection
    assert "post" in tasks_collection
    tasks_item = paths["/tasks/{task_id}"]
    assert "get" in tasks_item
    assert "put" in tasks_item
    assert "delete" in tasks_item

tests.name: test_openapi_json_content_type_is_json_not_html
actions: Verify response body is not HTML
expected: Response body does not start with '<'
trace: R-TASK-019: payload must be JSON, not HTML docs page
BVA: boundary between JSON and HTML response types; catches content-type mutation
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_content_type_is_json_not_html():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    assert "text/html" not in ct
    text = r.text.strip()
    assert not text.startswith("<"), "Response must not be HTML"
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
